import urllib.request

import time
apis = [
    ("Brainshop Public", "http://api.brainshop.ai/get?bid=153868&key=rcKonOgrUFmn5usX&uid=123&msg=hello"),

]

        with urllib.request.urlopen(req, timeout=5) as res:
